Schematics & board layout

Circuit, pin map, both sides of the board, component detail, every wire, then one figure per solder step.

1 2 3 3b 4 5 6 Step 1 — the buses and the ESP32 socket Step 2 — LEDs and resistors Step 3 — the four colored buttons Step 4 — AA / no / yes Step 5 — the 12 wires, then the LCD
One double-sided board, 30 × 42 holes. Everything lives on it: the control surface in columns 1–28, the ESP32 in a socket at columns 30–40 with its USB overhanging the edge. All soldering is done on one face, so the design works whether or not the holes are plated through. The ESP32 and the LCD both unplug — only the board is permanent.

Verified in millimetres, not hole counts. Every figure here is generated from tools/layout.py, the same file tools/verify-layout.py checks — so a drawing cannot disagree with the spec. Re-check with mise exec -- python tools/verify-layout.py.
